::: {.section-intro}
I'm Jane Zhang, a data professional and creative writer with an interest in how we understand and communicate a changing world.
:::

This website brings together my work in data science, fiction, and independent learning at the intersection of AI and energy. I want to share useful knowledge, explore ideas carefully, and make room for both analytical and creative work.

## Background & qualifications

My MSc research is titled *Physics-Informed Machine Learning in Space Plasma Physics*. Its [project page](projects/msc-space-plasma.qmd) will provide a home for the summary, methods, and research materials.

::: {.editorial-note}
**Profile in progress.** Details of my qualifications, professional background, and experience will be added here in my own words.
:::

## Interests & perspective

I'm interested in applied data science, machine learning, scientific research, and creative writing—including science fiction and memoirs.

My AI–energy work is an independent learning and exploratory research initiative. I plan to follow developments across the US, EU, and China, and write accessible explanations that distinguish evidence, interpretation, and open questions.
